Title: Admins' Microsoft 365 Cloud PC components may not be updating

User impact: Admins' Cloud PC components may not be updating.

More info: Admins notice that their Cloud PC components may not be updating; however, there's no impact to general user connectivity to the Cloud PCs.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Windows 365 and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.
